name: Datalayer Webform
description: Send datalayer events on Webform submission
project_description:
The Datalayer Webform Module is a robust and user-friendly solution for integrating Drupal webform information with Google Tag Manager (GTM) for enhanced tracking and analytics across multiple platforms. This module acts as a bridge , sending webform submission data to Datalayer, which can then be connected with various GTM tags to monitor user interactions, conversions, or custom-defined metrics on a Drupal site.

 By implementing this module, u sers can easily send their webform data to Datalayer for seamless integration with GTM , enabling better data-driven decision-making. With automatic data population and customizable tracking features, this module allows users to set up GTM tags to monitor specific form submissions or user interactions without custom coding or complex configurations.
